cash_engine.detail: The cash engine fell 42% from its 2022-12-31 peak to its 2023-12-31 trough, and is still below it (2016-12-31 -> 2025-12-31).

stress.detail: Owner earnings stayed inside the lines this layer draws on the tests it could run — the 2020 demand shock took owner earnings 17% below the prior peak (2020-12-31) and it came back; the 2022 rate shock left owner earnings 88% ABOVE the prior peak (2022-12-31).

predictability.detail: Not measured — predictability: only 0 usable annual revenue period(s), fewer than the 5 a growth dispersion needs; only 0 usable annual operating-margin period(s), fewer than the 5 a margin dispersion needs. Absent evidence is not safety (§7).

concentration.detail: This filer does not tag customer concentration, so this layer cannot see it — and silence here is not safety (§3.7); the cash-engine probe is what catches the same fragility by another route.
